_about: Allowlist of tools/terraform/iam_trust_inventory.py (S271 lessons guard G13). No account id, ARN or provider id goes in here (public repo): accounts are named by alias at run time (env IAM_TRUST_ACCOUNTS). services: AWS service principals a role may trust without a flag. oidc_providers: OIDC issuer hosts that are listed but not flagged (a GitHub trust must still pin the sub claim). acknowledged: flagged trusts that were reviewed; each stays in the report as 'acknowledged' with its reason. match is a glob on '<dir>:<address>' (static mode), 'plan:<address>' (plan mode) or 'live:<role name>' (live mode); kind is AWS, Federated, Service, CanonicalUser, NotPrincipal, * or unresolved. Never acknowledge a live Identity Center (AWSReservedSSO_*) role: it must stay visible in every audit until the account is in our organization.
